children: IC Group reported Q3 2026 revenue growth of 11% year over year, approximately 98% organic, and adjusted EBITDA of C$0.67M, up 64% year over year. It expects a Q4 restructuring charge of approximately C$1.0M and annual savings of approximately C$0.9M.
Growth was mostly organic; the release provides no revenue amount or comparison beyond the year-over-year rate.
Third consecutive quarter of positive adjusted EBITDA indicates improving operating performance; this is a non-IFRS measure.
The charge is a near-term cost, excluded from Q3 results, with severance payments expected over approximately 14 months.
Savings could offset restructuring costs over time, but the release does not quantify when they begin.
IC Insurance revenue grew 34%; IC Mobile 15%
Segment growth was uneven; IC Mobile's gross margin remains below target amid carrier cost increases and parallel platforms.

This is an early indication of improving profitability, with three consecutive quarters of adjusted EBITDA and reported revenue growth. Completion of the messaging-platform migration in Q4 and delivery of the estimated savings would be needed to support further margin improvement.
